title: Open the FF2 menu
description: Opens the main Freak Fortress 2 menu with many of the important player settings and options.

title: Boss selection
description: Opens boss-selection options. On newer FF2 Rewrite setups the selection system may use a boss whitelist rather than one permanently selected boss.

title: Boss selection
description: Respawns the RED team. Command only works as Hale & when there's 3 RED left

title: Boss queue / preference
description: Check your position for becoming the boss and access related boss-preference options when available.

title: Boss music toggle
description: Turns Freak Fortress boss music on or off.

title: Damage leaderboard
description: Displays the top damage players for the round. Use the corresponding off option if you no longer want the display.

title: Third person & First person in 1 command
description: Switches your camera between third person & first person.

title: Third person
description: Switches your camera to third person.

title: First person
description: Returns your camera to first person.

title: Engineer pads
description: Lets Engineer choose the pad replacement for teleporters, such as speed / jump-pad functionality.

title: Engineer amplifier
description: Lets Engineer replace the normal dispenser behavior with the amplifier / crit-beacon option when the server supports it.

title: Rock the vote
description: Votes to start the map-change / map-vote process. The chat form !rtv may also work depending on the server plugin.

title: Nominate a map
description: Choose a map to be considered for the next map vote. The chat form !nominate may also work.
